messages:
eva-cs: Customer report — acct id acct-9982, email: r***@example.com. They tried to apply promo code `EARLYBIRD25` during billing setup and got an invalid/expired error. Dashboard screenshot attached shows code active until 2027-01-01 for org.
eva-cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) sign up with email+phone 2) complete SMS MFA 3) go to Billing -> Redeem code -> error shown. They used the web UI after completing phone verification.
jen-support: can you paste the raw API response and any request ids? also did they ever click the email verification link earlier in the flow? sometimes users skip it.
eva-cs: API reply from apply endpoint:
```
POST /v1/credits/redeem
{ "code":"EARLYBIRD25", "account_id":"acct-9982" }
HTTP/1.1 400
{"error":"voucher.invalid","reason":"INVALID_OR_EXPIRED"}
```
Request-id: req_20260315_3f2b
matt-eng: running quick promo lookup...
promo-lookup-bot: Promo lookup for `EARLYBIRD25`:
- promo_id: P-5321
- expires_at: 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z
- scope: global
- flags: ["require_verified_email"]
- remaining_quota: 50
- consumption_policy: single_per_account
jen-support: looks like promo requires verified email. Could be the onboarding flow only set phone_verified and not email_verified. Can we inspect acct-9982 record?
matt-eng: pulling account snapshot now...
```
account_id: acct-9982
primary_email: r***@example.com
email_verified: false
phone_verified: true
identities: ["phone:+1555789", "email:r***@example.com"]
```
matt-eng: yep — email_verified=false. The code path that sets email_verified when a user confirms via magic link appears to be skipped if they do phone-first onboarding. We have a gap where email isn't marked even if user validated via email earlier.
eva-cs: customer insists they clicked the email link earlier. They uploaded the verification email timestamp. Can we manually grant the credit while engineering fixes the flow?
vikas-billing: we can perform a manual grant and mark promo as consumed for this account. Need confirmation to attach to ledger and a note. I'll proceed once you confirm.
jen-support: please proceed with manual credit and create an incident ticket for engineering. Tag matt-eng.
vikas-billing: manual credit issued: +$25 for EARLYBIRD25 to acct-9982. Transaction id: credit_20260315_b7d1. Marked redeemed_by_support and stamped single_per_account.
eva-cs: informed customer that we applied the credit manually; they verified the credit appears in billing and that the checkout accepted it after our action.
matt-eng: filing ENG-1302: "email_verified flag not set for phone-first onboarding -> breaks promo redemptions requiring verified email". Adding repro steps and logs (req_20260315_3f2b). ETA for hotfix: 48 hours for small server-side patch to set email_verified when appropriate.
jen-support: short-term mitigation: support can continue to manually grant credits and mark them consumed. Longer-term: either relax promo verification to accept phone_verified or fix onboarding to set email_verified appropriately. Prefer fixing onboarding.
promo-lookup-bot: Automated note appended: promo status unchanged; manual redemption recorded for acct-9982 (credit_20260315_b7d1). See ENG-1302 for remediation.
eva-cs: thanks everyone — closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
